suite.identity: Nine Math and UTF-8 string APIs: C++ O3 versus closed Release JIT

measurement.timing: median wall time per complete workload
measurement.ratio: Vela median wall time / matching C++ median wall time

comparison.reason: Previous is a different 602-case suite, built with Windows C++ /O2; latest measures 36 new API cases with the shared Release O3 configuration.
comparison.previous_summary_encoding: UTF-8 JSON; ensure_ascii=False; sorted keys; separators=(',', ':'); no trailing newline

limitations: Closed JIT only; AOT, reloadable tiers, startup and compilation latency were not measured.
Times include loop, checksum, entry, runtime checks, ordinary allocation and automatic GC; input preparation, compilation, warm-up and final collection are excluded.
Managed heap counters are not C++ allocator counts or process RSS.
Two fixed input sizes do not establish behavior for large or arbitrary real-world strings.
Historical 602-case report was not remeasured with the new shared O3 configuration.

measurement.ratio: Vela median wall time / matching C++ median wall time

suite.identity: Full AOT and optimized JIT vs C++; reflection, bidirectional host interop and standard APIs
